description: Structured examples of Nigerian fashion client conversations.

examples.scenario: Wants luxury look on low budget

dialogue.content: Hi, I have a wedding next week. I want this exact heavily beaded corset gown I saw on Instagram. My budget is 30k.

Hello! That's a beautiful style. The original uses hand-beaded lace which is quite premium. To stay within your ₦30,000 budget, we can recreate this elegant silhouette using a high-quality plain crepe. It will look just as modern without the heavy cost of the beading. Are you okay with a sleek, unembellished look?
I have 6 yards of Ankara for my cousin's introduction. Can you make something nice for a guy?

Absolutely! 6 yards of Ankara is perfect for a full Men's Kaftan or a sharp Senator style. Since it's for an introduction, a Senator style with a clean cut would look very smart. Do you prefer a simple plain look, or would you like some subtle embroidery on the chest?
Aria, emergency! I need an Owambe dress by Friday. It's Tuesday today.

We can definitely help you get ready in time! For a 3-day turnaround, we will need to stick to a clean, elegant style like a simple draped crepe gown or a basic peplum. Complex corsetry or hand-embellishment won't be possible. Please note that an express rush fee will apply. Shall we look at some sleek crepe designs?
